activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1754 as a representative Qing literary milestone because Dream of the Red Chamber is documented as circulating in manuscript from that year. The date represents the earliest documented manuscript-circulation milestone and is not asserted as the exact beginning of Cao Xueqin's composition.

sources.title: The Text of the Novel — Dream of the Red Chamber, University of Minnesota
sources.citation_text: The University of Minnesota resource states that Dream of the Red Chamber circulated in manuscript from 1754 and identifies Cao Xueqin as the author of at least the first eighty chapters.
